categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) and biopharmaceutical sectors. Its main business includes the development, production, and sales of IVD reagents and instruments, as well as innovative biopharmaceutical products such as antibody drugs, nucleic acid drugs, and live bacterial drugs. The company focuses on disease early screening, diagnosis, and treatment solutions, with strategic projects like the 'National Liver Health Project,' 'National Brain Health Project,' and 'National Cancer Early Screening Project.'
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced core technologies including phage large-capacity fully synthetic human antibody preparation, glycan capture technology, magnetic microparticle chemiluminescence, and upconversion luminescence technology. These platforms support the development of high-sensitivity diagnostic reagents and instruments, enabling automated, high-throughput, and point-of-care testing (POCT). The glycan capture technology is a proprietary platform for liquid biopsy, enabling rapid and automated exosome isolation and microRNA detection, with multiple patents and clinical trial progress.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hotgen serves clinical medical institutions across various levels, including tertiary hospitals, community health centers, township hospitals, third-party testing centers, and physical examination centers. Its products cover a wide range of disease areas such as liver diseases, cardiovascular diseases, infections, tumors, and neurodegenerative diseases. The company also supplies public safety sectors including disease control centers, public security, food safety, and emergency response organizations. Internationally, it has a presence in Europe and emerging markets, though foreign sales declined significantly in 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production bases in Beijing and Langfang. It has subsidiaries and branches in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, India, and the United States, supporting international sales and R&D. Domestic sales dominate revenue, while overseas sales, especially related to COVID-19 products, declined sharply in 2023. The company is expanding its international marketing and registration efforts to grow its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hotgen operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and biopharmaceutical products. It also produces some core biological active raw materials and quality control products, indicating partial upstream integration. The company manages procurement, production, and distribution, with a sales model combining direct sales and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation with high R&D investment, focusing on expanding its diagnostic reagent menus and developing new technologies such as glycan capture liquid biopsy, DNA methylation for cancer early screening, and AI-driven drug discovery. It actively develops biopharmaceutical pipelines including first-in-class and best-in-class antibody drugs, nucleic acid drugs, and live bacterial drugs. Strategic initiatives include building a full industry chain from diagnosis to treatment, deepening collaborations with top research institutions, and expanding clinical applications in liver health, brain health, and cancer early detection.
categories.revenue_model: Hotgen generates revenue primarily through the sale of in vitro diagnostic reagents, diagnostic instruments, and biological raw materials. The sales are conducted mainly via distributors with supplementary direct sales to end customers. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and licensing of proprietary technologies. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, with contracts mainly involving product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hotgen is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in China's IVD industry, especially strong in liver disease diagnostics and cancer early screening. It competes with international giants like Roche, Abbott, Beckman, and Siemens, particularly in tertiary hospitals. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies and a comprehensive product portfolio covering full immunodiagnostic scenarios from POCT to high-throughput platforms. It is recognized as a top innovative biotech company in China with multiple national awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Hotgen reported revenue of approximately RMB 541 million, a significant decline of 84.78% compared to 2022, mainly due to a sharp drop in COVID-19 related product sales. However, its non-COVID routine clinical business grew by 31.82%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 27.38 million, down 97.10% year-over-year. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 3.56 billion and net assets of RMB 3.36 billion. R&D investment remains high at 24.29% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation despite revenue fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hotgen emphasizes innovation-driven value, offering highly sensitive, automated, and full-scenario immunodiagnostic platforms that cater to diverse clinical needs from grassroots to high-end hospitals. Its proprietary glycan capture technology enables rapid and precise liquid biopsy for early cancer detection, positioning it as an international pioneer in this niche. The company’s integrated approach from diagnosis to treatment, combined with strong R&D capabilities and extensive clinical collaborations, provides differentiated products with high diagnostic accuracy and broad application coverage, enhancing patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency.
